verdict.rationale: Patent Center documents a sponsorship model: sponsored support staff can prepare and save filings, and Corresponding Practitioners can access those saved submissions. This shows a sanctioned delegated-actor rail exists, but the evidence is a single thin mention tied to one form. Missing for 10: documentation of how practitioners or registered attorneys are authorized to represent a company, how sponsorship is granted and revoked, trademark-side representative or designee rules, and independent corroboration.
